name: Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport
notes: Tried 28 Oct 2026: China eAIP (www.eaipchina.cn, www.aischina.com) - fetch blocked (permission not granted in time); only unofficial mirrors of old (2019) eAIP editions were found by search, which may not be used. Status stays unavailable; AD 2 needs a registered eAIP China account and a manual read. baiyunairport.com not retried (no rules on its home page in earlier runs).
